data.title: bn-1aw: Response envelope, machine mode, and generated exit table
data.description: One frozen scourge.response.v1 reply for parse, help, version, and command outcomes. Review global format resolution before parse, selector redaction, native diagnostic exit preservation, and argv actions. Full just check passed. Workspace binding and native calls are separate lanes; this change exercises refused and masked diagnostic outputs with a test-only dispatch.

data.body: risk:medium: Machine help loses resolved command identity and does not accept global selectors in both positions. On exact HEAD 361e740, `scourge --format json status --help` exits 0 with `result: "help"` and help text `Usage: scourge status [OPTIONS]`, but emits `command: null` despite the resolved `status` path. `scourge help status --format json` and `scourge help status --json` both exit 2 with `Unknown command.`; moving the same selector before `help` exits 0. The frozen machine guarantees require the canonical command after resolution and support format selectors after the command. Route help through a path that retains the resolved command and accepts global selectors before and after the advertised `help` command. Add process coverage for both help spellings and selector placements.

risk:medium: A stdout write failure discards structured stderr diagnostics even when stderr is healthy. The `?` on write_line(stdout, encoded) returns before the diagnostic loop. Running the existing response_process refusal child with open pipes gives exit 8 and a correlated scourge.diagnostic.v1 stderr event. Closing only the reader of its stdout pipe before spawning removes that event and reaches the test wrapper unwrap with BrokenPipe. This is a shared renderer defect, independent of the fixture unwrap. Preserve the response transport failure status as appropriate, but still emit the redacted correlated diagnostic to writable stderr. Add a writer-failure test against the shared renderer.

risk:low: Machine help echoes the caller-controlled executable basename. Passing argv[0] `scourge-review-seeded-secret` to the compiled binary with `--format json --help` via subprocess.run(executable=...) produced `Usage: scourge-review-seeded-secret [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]` in stdout. Its normal invocation and the seeded native refusal pass their respective redaction checks. Set a fixed Clap binary name for generated help so the renderer has the same input-redaction behavior on this path.

data.reason: Exact target 361e740b02d6e1622c33a231e59faf6ff7b7827a: the advertised machine help command drops resolved identity and rejects trailing selectors (th-3agdez), and a broken stdout suppresses an available correlated stderr diagnostic (th-2925cm). Full offline just check and focused CLI and wire tests passed; the findings are from additional process probes.

data.body: Fixed in 3a2d44ea9395cce1a09045321dfc428b6f5f877f. The explicit help command accepts the global selectors on either side of the command and uses the registered command path for response identity. The help flag also uses the parsed command. The argv[0] finding in th-3agdez.2 is covered by fixing Clap’s bin name to scourge. Process tests use hostile argv[0] at root and subcommand help, then check the usage error’s next argv also uses scourge. The format and environment precedence tests passed.

Fixed in 3a2d44ea9395cce1a09045321dfc428b6f5f877f. The renderer keeps the stdout result, writes correlated redacted diagnostic events, then returns a stdout failure if present. A real closed reader on the refusal process stdout pipe produces dependency exit 7 and exactly one stderr event equal to the normal refusal event. The seeded native secret remains absent and normal stdout remains one JSON object. Full just check passed.

data.reason: Verified at 3a2d44e. Both help spellings retain status, accept canonical format or the hidden alias on either side, obey FORMAT precedence, and produce one object. Independent process probes supplied seeded and malformed UTF-8 argv[0] values; generated help retains the fixed binary name and neither stream echoes the seed.

Verified at 3a2d44e. A real stdout pipe with no reader returns registered dependency exit 7. A writable stderr still receives exactly one redacted diagnostic byte-identical to the open-pipe event, with workspace, engagement, request key and run correlation. Independently verified refusal, wrong-listener and unavailable-tool fixture paths.

Reviewed persisted base db47cae through exact target 3a2d44ea9395cce1a09045321dfc428b6f5f877f. Both threads independently reproduced fixed. Full offline just check passed with local socket access, as did 7 CLI tests, 3 process cases, 15 core contracts and diff check. Extra process probes verified help identity and redaction, format precedence and TTY defaults, single deterministic JSON with all frozen exit rows, and correlated redacted diagnostics surviving a broken stdout pipe. Native/refusal evidence is from test-only dispatch.
